answer: Distinct-neighborhood routing gate makes each identity answer periodic pulse probes over independent paths to k distinct existing agents before it can transact. Probes split through a prism of disjoint relay groups, so a sybil must rent and keep alive k separate neighborhoods instead of one shared host. Shared hosting yields correlated timing and is isolated in a slow lagoon; each surviving fake identity still costs k live links and separate address/relay upkeep.
